defaults.stillSuffix: Photorealistic editorial studio photograph. Colour grade: warm neutral, gentle contrast, shadows leaning toward deep pine green, natural skin tones, fine film grain. Real skin texture, calm and focused, never laughing. No text, letters or numbers anywhere. No logos on clothing or devices. No paper, notebooks, pencils or calculators. No purple, no neon, no glowing orbs, no lens flare, no gradients in the backdrop. Device screens face away from the camera. Hands have five fingers.

stills.prompt: Overhead studio photograph looking straight down at a 16-year-old student sitting cross-legged on a seamless paper floor in solid deep pine green (#1F4D45) that fills the whole frame edge to edge. An open silver laptop rests on their knees, the lid seen from above so the screen is not visible. Sand-coloured hoodie, white socks, small white earbuds. Head tilted down toward the laptop, concentrating. Even soft top light, the student centred with generous flat pine green space around them.

stills.prompt: A frame that looks like a laptop webcam view on a video call: a 17-year-old student seen straight on from screen height, head and shoulders, centred, at her desk in her own bedroom in the evening. A warm desk lamp lights her face from the side; behind her a softly blurred bookshelf. She leans slightly toward the camera, listening hard, small wired earbuds in.
